units.source_text: 赴初濑进香的妹尼僧回来了，看见浮舟已经出家，不胜痛惜，

en.t: The younger nun who had gone to worship at Hatsuse returned, and when she saw that Ukifune had already taken the tonsure, she was overcome with grief.

units.source_text: 对她说道：“我身为尼僧，应该劝你出家。

en.t: She said to her, "As a nun myself, I ought to encourage you to renounce the world.

units.source_text: 但你年纪很轻，来日方长，今后如何度送岁月呢？

en.t: But you are still very young, with many years ahead of you. How will you pass the days from now on?

units.source_text: 我世寿几何，今日明日殊难预知。

en.t: As for me, who knows how much longer I have to live? It is hard to foresee even today or tomorrow.

units.source_text: 因此我多方考虑，向佛祈祷，保佑你终身平安无事。”

en.t: So I thought about it in every way and prayed to the Buddha to protect you and keep you safe all your life."

units.source_text: 说罢伏地痛哭，悲伤不已。

en.t: After saying this, she threw herself to the ground and wept bitterly, unable to contain her sorrow.

units.source_text: 浮舟推想：自己的生身母亲闻知她的死耗而又不见遗骸之时，也是如此悲伤的吧？

en.t: Ukifune thought to herself that when her own mother heard the news of her death and could not even see her body, she must have grieved like this too.

units.source_text: 便觉心如刀割，照例背转了身子，一言不答，那姿态非常娇美。

en.t: Her heart felt as if it were being cut by a knife, and as usual she turned her back and said nothing, her figure looking exceedingly lovely.

units.source_text: 妹尼僧又说：“你此举太孟浪了，好忍心啊！”

en.t: The younger nun said again, "What you have done was far too rash. How could you be so cruel?"

units.source_text: 便啼啼哭哭地替她准备尼装。

en.t: Then, still sobbing, she prepared nun's clothing for her.

units.source_text: 淡墨色法衣是她裁剪惯了的，其他褂子、袈裟则另央人缝制。

en.t: She was used to cutting the pale gray robes herself, while she asked others to sew the other jackets and kesa.

units.source_text: 别的尼僧也都来替她缝法衣，教她穿着。

en.t: The other nuns also came to sew robes for her and teach her how to wear them.

units.source_text: 她们说：“小姐来了，这山乡添了光彩，我们喜出望外。

en.t: They said, "Since the young lady came, this mountain village has gained new radiance, and our joy has been beyond all expectation.

units.source_text: 正想朝夕对晤，以慰岑寂。

en.t: We had hoped to sit with you morning and evening and ease our loneliness.

units.source_text: 岂知也当了出世之人，真乃遗憾之事啊！”

en.t: Who would have thought that you too would become one who has left the world? It is truly a great pity!"

units.source_text: 她们觉得可惜，大家埋怨僧都不该替她落发。

en.t: They all felt it was a shame, and everyone blamed the bishop for having shaved her head.
